title: Alszom, Alszol, Alszik – Sleep as an -ik Verb

sections.title: Another verb from the eszik/iszik family
sections.content: You already know *alszik* ("to sleep") from the food unit, where it came with eszik and iszik: an -ik verb with the -om/-em/-öm ending in the "I" form instead of the regular -ok/-ek/-ök. Like eszem/iszom, alszom follows the same shape.

items.english: I sleep eight hours every night.

sections.content: The infinitive of alszik is irregular too, just like enni and inni: it's *aludni*, not alszani — Eleget *kell* *aludni* ("You need to sleep enough") is the form you'll actually use most, together with *kell*.
